title: 多模态数据融合视角下江南古典园林美学特征量化建模研究

visual_audit.contact_sheets: 12 contact sheets covering all 116 pages reviewed
visual_audit.evidence_structure: pp1-14 abstract/problem/data; pp15-33 Q1 route/IGA/validation; pp34-61 Q2 element/open-close/AHP-entropy/ranking/validation; pp62-82 Q3 multimodal similarity + perspective extension; pp83-85 evaluation/references; pp86-116 printed Python code.

major_findings: Q1 printed code contains Dijkstra shortest-path route planning; no genetic algorithm/Pareto population, crossover, mutation or IGA implementation appears in the printed appendix.
Q2 printed code generates several nominally real features using np.random/random surrogates and later overwrites computed scores with fixed dictionaries matching the reported ranking.
Q2 paper states AHP-entropy weighting, while printed calculate_illusion_score() says AHP-CRITIC and then uses hard-coded weights rather than executing either weighting derivation.
Q3 printed multimodal code has stubbed loaders/empty feature construction, an omitted training loop, and obtains embeddings from an initialized-but-untrained network.
Q3 printed S_topology and S_behavior are computed from the same embedding with Euclidean/cityblock distances rather than the paper-described persistent-homology and HMM primitives.
Q3 perspective scorer contains pass/no-op data-loading/normalization helpers, clamps R2 to [0.75,0.95], and returns fixed 5-fold metrics 30.0/4.5/0.78.

why: full paper + 116/116 original-PDF visual audit + printed Python appendix static audit completed; code is not a complete faithful executable implementation and was not run on original data, so R3+ is not claimed
boundaries: S045 remains unread Train; S030/S031 remain Dev reserve; all Test papers remain frozen.
